cases.sentence: На третий день в Кане, в Галилее, был свадебный ___.
cases.translation: On the third day there was a wedding feast in Cana of Galilee.
cases.explain: Пир is the subject complement after был (there was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: У ___ сидели те, кто менял деньги.
cases.translation: By the tables sat those who exchanged money.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by, at) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мать Иисуса сказала ___, «Делайте то, что он вам скажет».
cases.translation: Jesus's mother said to the servants, 'Do whatever he tells you.'
cases.explain: Слугам is the indirect object of сказала (said to), which takes the dative case.
Воду is the direct object of превращает (turns/transforms something), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус вместе с матерью, братьями и ___ пошел в Капернаум.
cases.translation: Jesus went to Capernaum together with his mother, brothers, and disciples.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В ___ он увидел людей, продававших быков, овец и голубей.
cases.translation: In the temple he saw people selling oxen, sheep, and doves.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case for location.

reading.ru: Случилось так, что во время пира кончилось вино, и мать Иисуса тогда сказала ему, У них нет вина.
reading.question: What problem arose during the wedding feast?
reading.explain: The wine ran out during the feast, and Jesus's mother told him so.

reading.ru: Рядом стояло шесть больших каменных сосудов, которые иудеи использовали для обрядовых омовений.
reading.question: What were the six stone jars used for?
reading.explain: The six stone jars were used by the Jews for ceremonial washing.

reading.ru: Так Иисус положил начало знамением в Кане Галилейской и явил свою славу, и его ученики уверовали в него.
reading.question: What was the result of Jesus's first sign at Cana?
reading.explain: After this first sign, his disciples believed in him.

reading.ru: Сделав из веревок плеть, он выгнал из храма всех торговцев, а также овец и быков.
reading.question: What did Jesus do in the temple in Jerusalem?
options: He made a whip of cords and drove out the merchants, sheep, and oxen
He bought a lamb for sacrifice
reading.correct: He made a whip of cords and drove out the merchants, sheep, and oxen
reading.explain: Jesus made a whip and drove the merchants and animals out of the temple.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил им, «Разрушьте этот храм, и я в три дня восстановлю его».
reading.question: What did Jesus say he would do if the temple were destroyed?
options: Raise it up again in three days
Build a new temple in Rome
reading.correct: Raise it up again in three days
reading.explain: Jesus said he would raise the destroyed temple in three days.

reading.ru: Но сам Иисус не доверялся им, потому что Он знал всех, и Ему не нужно было знать о человеке по рассказам других, так как Он видел, что у каждого на душе.
reading.question: Why did Jesus not entrust himself to the crowd, even though many believed in him?
options: Because he knew everyone and what was in their hearts
Because they refused to pay taxes
reading.correct: Because he knew everyone and what was in their hearts
reading.explain: Jesus did not trust himself to them because he knew what was in each person.
